title: EBCDIC vs ASCII collating order in sequential match-merge
business_cause: Control-break logic processes branches in the wrong order, misposting amounts to suspense while grand totals still balance.
probable_cause: Faulty Java sorts by ASCII String.compareTo instead of EBCDIC byte order.
technical_cause: Faulty Java sorts by ASCII String.compareTo instead of EBCDIC byte order.
business_fix: Make the Java migration sort and match branch codes in the same order as the COBOL program.
fix_sentence: Use IBM1047 Charset or a custom Comparator for EBCDIC byte order.
cobol_rule: Branch codes are compared in EBCDIC order, which the program sets with its alphabet and collating sequence clauses.
